d:
Role: She becomes the Fifth Hokage of the Hidden Leaf Village (Konohagakure), leading the village through some of its most difficult periods.
Medical Ninja: Tsunade is regarded as the greatest medical ninja of her generation. She revolutionized medical ninjutsu and established the rule that every ninja squad should include a medical ninja.
Superhuman Strength: By precisely controlling chakra, she can deliver devastating punches capable of shattering boulders, buildings, and even giant summons.
Byakugō Seal (Strength of a Hundred Seal): Tsunade stores chakra over a long period in a diamond-shaped mark on her forehead. When released, it grants massive chakra reserves and enables rapid regeneration, allowing her to recover from severe injuries almost instantly.
Summoning Technique: She can summon Katsuyu, a giant slug that helps heal allies across the battlefield and can divide into smaller slugs to assist many people at once.
